##### Project general facts

Four Seasons Private Residences DIFC is a visionary residential project in the one of the city's most prestigious lifestyle and business destinations. Comprising four aligned towers rising above Gate Avenue, this development features a limited collection of fifty-nine exceptional homes, including two exclusive penthouses. Designed by acclaimed Pritzker Prize-winning architect Sir David Chipperfield, the property presents a striking composition of non-parallel façades that reveal a gentler, curved internal façade embracing an immersive courtyard garden. A joint venture between H&H Development, Bright Start, and Four Seasons, it marks the brand's second standalone residential offering in Dubai.

Residents enjoy an entire floor dedicated to an extensive collection of world-class amenities. These include a resort-style infinity swimming pool with a terrace and pool bar, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, a spa with sauna and steam rooms, and a private movement studio. Leisure facilities also feature a golf simulator, a private theatre, a cigar lounge, and a dedicated children's playroom and pool. Every aspect of daily living is managed by a dedicated Director of Residences and a 24-hour concierge, supported by valet parking, security, and bespoke à la carte services such as private chefs and housekeeping.

Every residence is fully furnished by the renowned international atelier Tihany Design, reflecting a sophisticated blend of creativity and functionality. Interiors feature soaring ceilings, travertine marble flooring, and large windows that open to private terraces with panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, or the development's manicured gardens. The residences offer generous three to five-bedroom layouts, including custom Italian kitchens, dedicated office spaces, and family rooms. The two penthouses are even more expansive, featuring their own private swimming pools and elevated finishes.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled along Gate Avenue within the prestigious Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), this exceptional location places residents at the nexus of commerce, culture, and lifestyle. DIFC is a vibrant mixed-use community where world-class art galleries, luxury retailers, and fine-dining restaurants line the indoor-outdoor promenade, creating a dynamic environment for living and leisure.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled connectivity and proximity to key destinations. The sophisticated urban getaway of Four Seasons Hotel DIFC is just a quick stroll away, while the beachfront Four Seasons Resort Jumeirah Beach is a short drive. Iconic landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai are minutes away, ensuring residents remain at the heart of the city's vibrant energy.

For those seeking a residence that epitomizes timeless luxury, architectural innovation, and an address that offers both privacy and prestige, DIFC delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious address makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — sophisticated, connected and effortlessly refined.
